Only after complete trace preservation: S0-1, S0-2, S0-3, S0-4, S0-6

S0_5.inventory: Union of artifact IDs and Actions run references in base audit root00_SUMMARY_KO.md, every task MANIFEST.json and nested Actions/receipt JSON. Expand each explicitly referenced run to all its artifacts. Record every source path. Include input and summary-only artifacts, not only examples. Exclude followup's own newly-created receipt artifact to avoid an infinite self-reference; record it separately.
S0_5.verification: Original artifact digest if present, full original ZIP bytes and SHA256, immutable release asset URL/id, full release download readback bytes/SHA256. Existing same-name assets are reused only on byte/hash match, never overwritten. No missing original digest is PASS. Complete inventory reconciliation required before post-preservation analysis.

S0_1.preserve: Numeric CSV and original decision/lock contents remain byte-identical. Append clearly post-hoc validity metadata to related manifest/results/locks; record original file SHA256 and original bytes in additive snapshots. Mark only SRC_TAP arms/_src comparison columns and SRC directories invalid; B_OLD/B_REFIT_ONLY remain valid.

S0_2.input: Original immutable reference_ae/PACKETS_SOURCE_LABELS.csv.gz channel==los, not any SRC_TAP-adjusted cache
S0_2.residual: e=z_r-(d(x_GT)+B_OLD); establish raw range and true geometric-distance columns/pose provenance. If only a precomputed residual is present, certify its generator formula against pinned source and independently reconstruct distance/range before using it. Never substitute a source-tap-adjusted residual.
S0_2.quantiles: NumPy linear method; population RMSE and population mean; no sample filtering beyond channel==los and case identities. Nonfinite or duplicate keys are errors.
S0_2.theta: Confirmed original SourceFFD GT relative antenna azimuth convention, wrapped into [-180,180). Use original verified column or reconstruct from confirmed anchor/mount/pose contract; no guessed geometry.
S0_2.bin_rules: Half-open [low,high), last infinite distance bin; theta180 wraps to-180. Report empty bins explicitly.
S0_2.tap_transition: Within each case sort by original monotonic numeric pose_id, stable original row index as tie-break (duplicate pose_id is an error). Original detected common tap k=round(z_r/delta), verified |z_r/delta-k|<=1e-6; first row FIRST, later rows TRANSITION iff k differs from immediately preceding case row, else STABLE. Do not sort by residual or distance. If tap grid cannot be certified, report exact missing tap mapping rather than invent transitions.
S0_2.clock_population: Reconstruct prior7251 rows by exact case/pose_id membership from preserved native T6 evidence or frozen recursive traces, match to archive rows, and report full9519 versus recursive7251 side by side. Never change the requested archive count.
S0_2.task_status_rule: CLOSED_QUANTIZATION iff every case |mean_m|<0.01 and rmse_over_sigma_q in[0.8,1.2] and expected counts/inputs certified; else OPEN with failed/missing cases.
S0_2.scientific: If criteria satisfied: SUPPORTED_BUT_LIMITED for quantization-scale consistency; otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED. No unique-cause or conditional-unbiasedness claim.

S0_3.rule: Trace generator code and explicit original frame inclusion/time window/row mapping before recomputing old population. Compare SourceFFD B_OLD e_r and SourceFFD e_s on original population and on frozen R2 t>=30s829-frame population. Identify old e_s LUT/SourceFFD by source evidence. Missing original mapping is a blocker, never inferred from nearby statistics.
S0_3.slide_population_choice: Use SourceFFD B_OLD t>=30s829-frame R2 population for the slide, explicitly labelled, if its original row mapping is certified. Old-population comparison is an audit column, not a replacement chosen by outcomes.

S0_4.support: Original fixed5 harmful and5 beneficial events and original thresholds unchanged. At least3 harmful events with positive skip gain have D3 or D6 recovery>=0.5 and that same diagnostic has harm<=0.5 of skip harm on ALL fixed5 beneficial events. Missing/sign-changed beneficial safety cannot pass.
S0_4.falsification: At least3 fixed harmful events have D1 orD2 recovery>=0.5 and both valid D3,D6 effects<0.2. Missing valid diagnostics cannot establish small effect.
S0_4.D3_boundary: D3 corrects event-entry psi prior mean only, with covariance retained; does not eliminate all prior/state/covariance error and cannot reject the entire prior mechanism.
